provenance.sourceName: DuPont Kapton HN Polyimide Film technical data sheet (copy hosted by Epec)
provenance.verificationMethod: Table 1 Physical Properties at 23 C: Density 1.42 g/cc, ASTM D-1505-90, identical for all four listed gauges (25/50/75/125 um); 1.42 g/cm3 x 1000 = 1420 kg/m3.

p.022: saturation 13,000 G; DC-bias table for 60 mu: %mu = 100/(1 + 2.75E-05 H^2.139), H in Oe (read at 300 dpi; the PDF has no text layer). Converted to A/m: b = 0.01 * 2.75e-5 * 79.577^-2.139. Composition not published (stored proprietary). Bsat temperature not stated (stored at 25 C).

provenance.derivation: field = end of the published magnetization curve
provenance.verificationMethod: Saturation field: the catalogue's normal magnetization curves (p.025) end at 1000 Oe near 10.5 kG, below the stated 13 kG; the field is stored as 1000 Oe, the end of the published curve.

provenance.derivation: per-band Steinmetz fitted to the catalogue loss formula
provenance.verificationMethod: Losses: catalogue p.024 formula for 60-125 mu, P[mW/cm3] = B^2.240 (2.498 f + 0.0220 f^1.999), B in kG peak AC, f in kHz, fitted to Steinmetz per band.
